name: Bat
intro: A bat is a mammal that can fly. It sleeps upside down during the day.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A bat has a furry body.
Its wings are thin skin with no fur.
The skin stretches between long finger bones.
Many bats have big ears.
The biggest bats have wings wider than a grown-up is tall.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Bats live almost everywhere on Earth.
They do not live in the coldest places.
Bats rest in caves, trees, and buildings.
Some bats sleep through the winter.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Most bats eat insects.
Some bats eat fruit.
Some bats drink nectar from flowers.
Fruit bats find food by sight and smell.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby bat is called a pup.
A mother bat usually has one pup a year.
A new pup has no fur and its eyes are closed.
The pup drinks its mother's milk.
It learns to fly in a few weeks.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly.
Bats hang upside down to rest.
Some bats find food by listening to echoes.
Bats help plants by carrying pollen and seeds.
Bats are not blind; they can see.

vocab.meaning: An animal with fur or hair that drinks milk from its mom as a baby.
Finding things by making sounds and listening for echoes.
Yellow dust that flowers need to make seeds.
